items.name: modal-manager
items.title: Global Modal Manager
items.description: Client-only LIFO modal stack with nested Dialog / Alert Dialog primitives, typed overlay settlement, and the Overlay Layer Registry.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Global Confirm Dialog
items.description: Modal-manager Alert Dialog workflow for boolean confirm and confirm-and-run, with ErrorClassification errors.

items.name: alert-prompt-dialog
items.title: Global Alert / Prompt Dialog
items.description: Promise-based alert on the alert-dialog surface and single-input prompt on the dialog surface, both hosted on modal-manager.

items.name: loading-overlay
items.title: Global Loading Overlay
items.description: Per-token pending/succeeded/failed/released ownership with fail-wins aggregate reduction, named scopes, and optional overlay-layer registration when blocking.

items.name: action-runner
items.title: Async Action Wrapper
items.description: Scoped typed async lifecycles with optional confirm and loading-overlay adapters, ErrorClassification failures, and no motion or toast library.

items.name: sheet-manager
items.title: Drawer / Sheet Manager
items.description: Client-only LIFO sheet stack separate from modal-manager, with SheetSettlement, side policies, pending dismissal locks, and overlay-layer registration.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Searchable command surface hosted as a modal-manager dialog containing Command. Destructive commands fail closed without confirm. Embeddable local palettes supported.

items.name: authentication-core
items.title: Authentication Core
items.description: Session-centric adapter-first core with AuthUser, Session, UX-only session seed, and a server-only helper. Sign-in failures are ErrorClassification.

items.name: pending-auth-action
items.title: Pending Action After Auth
items.description: User-bound, versioned pending action intents with a tab-local default store and a bounded resume operation. Mutation replay is opt-in. Not TanStack Query.

items.name: auth-guard
items.title: Auth Guard
items.description: Placeholder registry item.

items.name: session-refresh
items.title: Session Refresh
items.description: Opt-in client refresh coordinator for authentication-core: single-flight refresh, ReplayPolicy request replay, and optional fetch interception. Does not invent unsupported refresh.

items.name: optimistic-mutation
items.title: Optimistic Mutation Helper
items.description: Placeholder registry item.

items.name: error-classification
items.title: Error Classification
items.description: UI-neutral owner of ErrorClassification and classifyError. Maps failures to a stable category, safe message, retryability, and optional redacted details.

items.name: draft-autosave
items.title: Draft Autosave
items.description: User-namespaced, versioned draft persistence with tab-local sessionStorage by default, debounced saves, revision conflicts on shared stores, and explicit restore/discard.

items.name: unsaved-changes
items.title: Unsaved Changes Guard
items.description: Consumer-owned dirty-state guard with injected confirm-dialog, one-time navigation retry, and documented Next App Router limits.

items.name: feature-flags
items.title: Feature Flag Provider
items.description: Adapter-first flag provider with schema defaults, bootstrap snapshots, explicit refresh, and a server-only module.

items.name: keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: Keyboard Shortcut Registry
items.description: Client-only shortcut registry with named shortcut scopes, single-chord grammar, effect-based registration, and deterministic conflicts.

items.name: offline-banner
items.title: Online / Offline Detection Banner
items.description: Client-observing connectivity snapshot with an accessible, non-blocking banner. Optional abortable reachability probe; not an overlay layer and no mutation queue.

items.name: idle-timeout
items.title: Idle / Session Timeout
items.description: Placeholder registry item.

items.name: error-reporting
items.title: Error Reporting Boundary
items.description: Adapter-first reporting boundary: classify via error-classification, send a redacted ErrorReport, opt-in consent. Recovery does not wait on the report. Feedback UI is consumer-owned.
